name: Svam Agritech Limited
about: Svam Agritech Limited engages development of software in India. It is involved in the purchase and sale of software, hardware, and various accessories related to computers. The company also owns and operates a chain of computers that distribute software developed by third parties. In addition, it offers services in the areas of turnkey software projects, communication and networking, system reengineering, corporate and professional programs, software conversion/migration/redesign, GIS, customized software development, product development, facility management, and downsizing and system integration. The company serves information technology sector. The company was formerly known as Svam Software Limited and changed its name to Svam Agritech Limited in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Indore, India.
